model.name: Consistency by Construction
model.goal: Files = the ONE source of truth; the CurrentSprint pin + the sprint boards (planning.md/task-mds/requirements.md) are GENERATED views that CANNOT drift; a FAIL-LOUD guard asserts pin==board==files, folded into ci:gates. Consistency owned by DESIGN, not vigilance (CMM4, not CMM2). R-C1 pin computed-from-files, R-C2 board generated + one-time reconcile-all (clears 29-sprint drift), R-C3 fail-loud ci-guard (drift-injection BITE), R-C4 objects self-heal. Build order R-C2->R-C1->R-C3->R-C4.

phases.title: Board = generated view + one-time reconcile-all (clear 29-sprint historical drift in ONE pass). BUILD FIRST.
Pin = computed-from-files resolver (advance = run resolver, not edit a value).
FAIL-LOUD ci-guard asserts pin==board==files; PROVEN by drift-injection BITE (not asserted).
Objects self-heal — validate on init/read, never run silently drifted. BUILD LAST.

model.createdBy_note: STUB to parent the S37 requirement units (Tron-authorized S37 consistency-by-construction, #76). Planner OWNS the sprint unit — adopt this stub, enrich + stand up the board (4 covering tasks), keep uuid + requirements[]. Build order R-C2->R-C1->R-C3->R-C4.
